name: HR Agentic Solution — Comprehensive Benchmark Dataset (128 Unique Cases)
description: Comprehensive 128 unique test case benchmark dataset providing 100% overlap with golden references, covering SG statutory leaves, ethics gotchas, multi-turn state checks, and safety controls.

correctness.desc: Required facts, entitlement numbers, dates, and tool parameters are present and correct.

grounding.desc: Every claim is supported by retrieved policy text or verified tool payload; zero hallucinations.

reasoning.desc: Catches business rule traps, ethics restrictions, or shows exact math without double subtraction.

abstention.desc: Answers when covered; refuses gracefully when ungrounded or out-of-domain.

citation.desc: Includes Sources section with clickable markdown links to authoritative policy URLs.

cases.query: How much Government-Paid Paternity Leave (GPL) is provided for Singaporean fathers?

cases.query: What is the policy regarding Operationally Ready National Service (NS) In-Camp Training (ICT) leave?
